# Price the run, the switch, and the fuel — not a flat $8,000 hang.

> Price a residential standby generator install from the nameplate feeder, transfer switch, pad, gas or propane line, and setback — plus walk-away price, dollars per kW, and how many times a typical 22 kW natural-gas hang this house really is.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
